DASH_PASSWORD.description: Your password for this server: it opens the dashboard and approves each AI app you connect. At least **12** characters; a password manager's generator is ideal. Keep it to yourself.

TOKEN_ENC_KEY.description: Encrypts your Instagram token. Any random string of **32 or more** characters, for example from your password manager's generator. Keep it secret and don't reuse it.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs your dashboard login. Another random string of **32 or more** characters, different from `TOKEN_ENC_KEY`.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: This Worker's address, lowercase: `https://<worker name>.<your subdomain>.workers.dev`. Not sure? Deploy anyway: `/dash` will show the exact value to put here.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth state for MCP clients. Create a new one.

DB.description: Holds your Instagram account, drafts and the audit log. Create a new one.
